pairs: Et cœpit illis in parabolis loqui:
And he began to speak to them in parables:
and surrounded it with a hedge,
and he loaned it out to farmers,
and he set out on a long journey.
Et misit ad agricolas in tempore servum ut ab agricolis acciperet de fructu vineæ.
And in time, he sent a servant to the farmers, in order to receive some of the fruit of the vineyard from the farmers.
beat him and sent him away empty.
Et iterum misit ad illos alium servum:
And again, he sent another servant to them.
And they wounded him on the head,
and they treated him with contempt.
Adhuc ergo unum habens filium carissimum,
Therefore, having still one son, most dear to him,
et illum misit ad eos novissimum,
he sent him also to them, at the very end,
But the settlers said one to another:
And then the inheritance will be ours.’
And they cast him out of the vineyard.
what will the lord of the vineyard do?”
“He will come and destroy the settlers.
And he will give the vineyard to others.”
“And so, have you not read this scripture?:
‘The stone which the builders have rejected,
hic factus est in caput anguli:
the same has been made the head of the corner.
By the Lord has this been done,
et est mirabile in oculis nostris?
and it is wondrous in our eyes.’”
And they sought to take hold of him,
cognoverunt enim quoniam ad eos parabolam hanc dixerit.
For they knew that he had spoken this parable about them.
And leaving him behind, they went away.
Et mittunt ad eum quosdam ex pharisæis,
And they sent some of the Pharisees
so that they might trap him with words.
And these, arriving, said to him:
scimus quia verax es, et non curas quemquam:
we know that you are truthful and that you do not favor anyone;
nec enim vides in faciem hominum,
for you do not consider the appearance of men,
sed in veritate viam Dei doces.
but you teach the way of God in truth.
Is it lawful to give the tribute to Caesar,
or should we not give it?”
And knowing their skill in deception,
Bring me a denarius, so that I may see it.”
And they brought it to him.
So in response, Jesus said to them,
“Then render to Caesar, the things that are of Caesar;
the things that are of God.”
who say there is no resurrection, approached him.
Moyses nobis scripsit, ut si cujus frater mortuus fuerit, et dimiserit uxorem,
Moses wrote for us that if any man’s brother will have died and left behind a wife,
and not have left behind sons,
accipiat frater ejus uxorem ipsius, et resuscitet semen fratri suo.
his brother should take his wife to himself and should raise up offspring for his brother.
So then, there were seven brothers.
And the first took a wife,
et mortuus est non relicto semine.
and he died without leaving behind offspring.
And neither did he leave behind offspring.
each of the seven received her and did not leave behind offspring.
Therefore, in the resurrection, when they will rise again,
to which of them will she be a wife?
For each of the seven had her as wife.”
And Jesus responded by saying to them:
For when they will be resurrected from the dead,
sed sunt sicut angeli in cælis.
but they are like the Angels in heaven.
But concerning the dead who rise again,
non legistis in libro Moysi, super rubum,
have you not read in the book of Moses,
how God spoke to him from the bush, saying:
He is not the God of the dead,
Therefore, you have gone far astray.”
who had heard them arguing, drew near to him.
et videns quoniam bene illis responderit,
And seeing that he had answered them well,
interrogavit eum quod esset primum omnium mandatum.
he questioned him as to which was the first commandment of all.
“For the first commandment of all is this:
The Lord your God is one God.
et diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo,
And you shall love the Lord your God from your whole heart,
But the second is similar to it:
‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
Majus horum aliud mandatum non est.
There is no other commandment greater than these.”
And the scribe said to him:
in veritate dixisti, quia unus est Deus,
You have spoken the truth that there is one God,
et non est alius præter eum.
and there is no other beside him;
Et ut diligatur ex toto corde,
and that he should be loved from the whole heart,
et diligere proximum tamquam seipsum, majus est omnibus holocautomatibus, et sacrificiis.
And to love one’s neighbor as one’s self is greater than all holocausts and sacrifices.”
Jesus autem videns quod sapienter respondisset,
And Jesus, seeing that he had responded wisely, said to him,
dixit illi: Non es longe a regno Dei.
“You are not far from the kingdom of God.”
Et nemo jam audebat eum interrogare.
And after that, no one dared to question him.
And while teaching in the temple,
Quomodo dicunt scribæ Christum filium esse David?
“How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
Ipse enim David dicit in Spiritu Sancto:
For David himself said in the Holy Spirit:
donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
until I set your enemies as your footstool.’
Ipse ergo David dicit eum Dominum,
Therefore, David himself calls him Lord,
and so how can he be his son?”
Et multa turba eum libenter audivit.
And a great multitude listened to him willingly.
Et dicebat eis in doctrina sua:
And he said to them in his doctrine:
who prefer to walk in long robes
and to be greeted in the marketplace,
et in primis cathedris sedere in synagogis,
and to sit in the first chairs in the synagogues,
and to have the first seats at feasts,
qui devorant domos viduarum sub obtentu prolixæ orationis:
who devour the houses of widows under the pretense of long prayers.
These shall receive the more extensive judgment.”
And Jesus, sitting opposite the offertory box,
aspiciebat quomodo turba jactaret æs in gazophylacium,
considered the way in which the crowd cast coins into the offertory,
and that many of the wealthy cast in a great deal.
Cum venisset autem vidua una pauper,
But when one poor widow had arrived,
she put in two small coins,
quoniam vidua hæc pauper plus omnibus misit, qui miserunt in gazophylacium.
that this poor widow has put in more than all those who contributed to the offertory.
Omnes enim ex eo, quod abundabat illis,
For they all gave from their abundance,
hæc vero de penuria sua omnia quæ habuit misit totum victum suum.
she gave from her scarcity, even all that she had, her entire living.”
